# Code of Conduct

AeroBIM is a public engineering repository. The maintainer set is small; the bar is still explicit.

## Expected

- Technical disagreement is welcome. Personal attacks, harassment, and doxxing are not.
- Do not post customer, NDA, or personally identifiable project data in issues, pull requests, or discussions.
- Do not file a public issue for a vulnerability that can be exploited. Follow [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).
- Do not present fixture results, competitor claims, or evaluation targets from the TZ as AeroBIM product measurements.

## Enforcement

Reports go privately to the maintainers listed in [`MAINTAINERS.md`](MAINTAINERS.md), or through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/KonkovDV/AeroBIM/security/advisories/new) when the matter is a security issue.

The maintainers may edit or close a contribution, or block an account, when this file is ignored. There is no SLA beyond the acknowledgement window in `SECURITY.md`.
